name: Bacchikoi!
source:
The young transfer student, Toshu Kanada, gets himself recruited in a nearly-falling apart baseball club. His once small world opens up as he gets to know his teammates Ichiru and Masaru. Lead Toshu with his choices and take teamwork and friendship to a whole new level!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141008093431/http://blackmonkey-pro.com:80/project/bacchikoi/]official site[/url]]
translation:
年轻的转校生金田东树被一家濒临崩溃的棒球俱乐部招募。当他认识了队友一留和胜时，他曾经的小世界打开了。用他的选择带领Toshu，将团队合作和友谊提升到一个全新的水平！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141008093431/http://blackmonkey-pro.com:80/project/bacchikoi/]官方网站[/url]]
